description: This two-level nested pie chart illustrates the composition and categorization of different types of characters. The inner ring is divided into three main categories: "Virtual Characters" in light blue, which occupies the vast majority of the chart (approximately 75%); "Real Characters" in light green (approximately 10-15%); and a third pink slice (approximately 10-15%) that features a partially obscured label covered by a grey rectangular box above the central word "Characters." The outer ring further subdivides these primary groups into a total of thirteen segments. The light blue "Virtual Characters" section is split into five segments, appearing in roughly descending order of size counterclockwise: "Comic Characters," "Movie Characters," "Teleplay Characters," "Novel Characters," and "Game Characters." The light green "Real Characters" section is divided into seven smaller segments labeled "Scientists," "Artists," "Athletes," "Writers," "Musicians," "Actors," and "Influencers." The pink inner category corresponds to a single, unlabeled pink segment in the outer ring. The chart does not include a separate legend or explicit percentage labels; rather, category names are placed directly on or adjacent to their respective outer slices, with the text color corresponding to the slice's hue (dark blue for virtual characters, dark green for real characters). Aside from the grey obscuring box in the center, no slices are exploded or visually offset.
